steps.speaker: Marv
steps.content: Aaahhh...!!!
Marv utters a final shriek as its body withers away. The Ambrosia flowing about in the space quickly dries up, and the sweet aroma vanishes.
The FAC counter-Mania joint operation's temporary headquarters at the scene of the crisis in Eastside's District 14.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The peak of the M-value is falling rapidly. The scope of Mania contamination has shrunk, and some of the Sleepwalkers have regained consciousness!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Alert the whole task force to seize this opportunity and counterattack!
Crisis epicenter in the corridor of the Midsummer Night's Club.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The shackles are reacting! Hella, Chief is back... He's in the banquet room!
steps.female_content: The shackles are reacting! Hella, the Chief is back... She's in the banquet room!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the **** took you so long? Go go go, I still need to... arghhh!
To her shock, she trips over a large figure that suddenly appeared.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Huh? Doyle? How come you're here?
The chessboard gradually melts away.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: ...I knew this is how it would end.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You can't win against him, little snake...
steps.female_content: You can't win against her, little snake...

steps.content: The colors of the radiant stage fade slowly at the center of the dream.

Some resist sorrowfully, clutching the withered and broken wooden frames, reluctant to leave their dreams. Others break free from the wooden frames roaring, rushing through the cracks and disappearing into the light.
You've won. This epic battle has sapped you of all your energy. Your tightly wound nerves finally relax a bit, and you collapse to the ground, unable to move.
Even after being suppressed for so many years, the monster Marv is far stronger and stranger than you had imagined. He's different from other Corruptors, he's...

You've no time to ponder. The woman who once commanded Marv as her servant saunters to your side, clutching the empty Bottle of Dreams. She looks down at you, but you are unable to see her expression clearly.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: ...I didn't expect it to end like this.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You crashed my performance, ruined the sweet dreams, and drove everyone back to the miserable real world.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You used all your might to destroy my last shred of joy...
She kneels down, caressing your cheek with her cold hand. A dark little snake slithers from her arm onto you and chokes you. Now you can feel her power.
It's a powerful, icy force, manic and out of control.

I know you can't forgive me for destroying your world, but then you should also understand why I rejected you... It has nothing to do with whether your dreams are good or not. It's because you've been wantonly destroying our world.
She doesn't respond, nor does she move.
After a long time, icy droplets splash onto your face. One drop, two drops...
It's her tears.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: How could I hurt you all... I wanted to... give happiness to all of you...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: If I could heal your pain, make you happy, and bring you into a beautiful dream, even just once... You would definitely choose me...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: If only you would choose me...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let us choose for ourselves, Serpent.
...Why on earth are you so persistent?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Happiness is not bestowed upon by others. Just like pain and misery, it's everyone's own experience. We came all this distance in our own way, so let us choose where we ought to go. Don't destroy our path.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Maybe someday you will also find something worth cherishing in the real world.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: ...Ha... You really think so?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: With your strength, Doyle's black goo is no match against you. You could've easily killed him, but you didn't... You just wanted him to be happy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So why are you so stubbornly persistent? Did you... experience a lot of pain before?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Ha... Is that important?

You hear the voices of Hella, Hecate, and Nightingale through the crack in the Realm of Dreams. The crack continues to expand, and light shines in, illuminating the fissures on her body. Her body is crumbling away, riddled with age-old injuries.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: ...There's no longer a stage for me here.
Her cold hand leaves your cheek. You try to catch her and shackle her, but your body doesn't respond.
Serpent stands up. Her expression is grim as she leans gently toward you.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Next time, I'll bring you a "real" sweet dream.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: ...Goodbye.
You can only watch the show end as a spectator. You gradually lose consciousness, following everyone else and drifting through the crack back to reality.
Only the performer of dreams remains behind, disappearing alongside the bubble-like stage.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Hello? You little brat! It took you this long to call me? I'm on vacation, so I'm not writing any reports or working overtime. Let's talk about something else!

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: When are you coming to Eastside again? Whether you're here for work or for fun, stop by my house for dinner. I've actually learned how to make the hangover drink properly now.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Well, I'm still a grouchy old man, but I'm very happy now.
<size=40>　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　The show has ended.</size>
<size=40>　　　　　　　　　　　　　Whether you stay or not, I wish you...</size>
<size=40>　　　　　　　　　　　　　Sweet, happy dreams tonight.</size>
